items.headline: Sesko returns to training as injury recovery progresses
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is back training on grass after injury, bulked up in training but expected to slim down during full training preparation.

items.headline: Andrey Santos completes £48m move from Chelsea
items.summary: Brazilian defensive midfielder Andrey Santos signed for £48 million plus £2 million in probable add-ons from Chelsea, impressing with his intelligence off the ball.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans signs as United activate Aston Villa release clause
items.summary: Belgium captain Youri Tielemans, 29, has joined Manchester United via release clause activation at Aston Villa.

items.headline: De Ligt absent from pre-season following back surgery
items.summary: Matthijs de Ligt has not played since November 2025 after undergoing back surgery and is expected to miss opening weeks of the new season.

items.headline: Ugarte faces lengthy absence after World Cup knee injury
items.summary: Manuel Ugarte suffered a devastating knee injury in the World Cup group stage against Spain and is expected to miss majority of the new campaign.

items.headline: Manchester United pursue Lewis Hall from Newcastle
items.summary: Manchester United set to open discussions with Newcastle over left-back Lewis Hall, seen as ideal replacement for injury-prone Luke Shaw.

items.headline: Karl Darlow joins as goalkeeper backup
items.summary: Karl Darlow has been brought into Manchester United as goalkeeper backup during the summer transfer window.
